title: Listen and Choose a Response — Career

questions.stem: I'm starting a new job at the hospital next week.

options.A: That's great! What will you be doing there?
options.B: I started there last week as well.
options.C: The hospital is near the train station.

questions.explanation: Showing interest with a follow-up question is a natural reply to news; the other options mismatch tense or pronoun.
